title: Reference color tokens instead of raw color literals in UI files

facts.note: Repository-level design-root-exists fact (not a filter on the touched file's path): the rule applies only if such a directory exists anywhere in the repo. Needs an observer that checks repo tree for existence of a design root. Touched UI files may live anywhere, inside or outside the design root.

Eligible UI file extensions anywhere in the repository; .ts/.mts only count for HTML they author in string/template/tagged-template literals. Excluded: test files (*.test.*, *.spec.*), vendored/build directories, and files under the design root's tokens/foundations layer.

values: UI code outside the design root
facts.note: Any UI file not in the tokens/foundations layer, including UI files outside the design root entirely.

values: raw color literal written in a declaration value
facts.note: Diff/detector-level fact: bun_design_system_detector finding a hex/rgb(a)/hsl(a) literal in a CSS declaration, style attribute, <style> block, JSX style object, fill/stroke/bgcolor attribute, or .ts/.mts literal HTML.

fires: A .tsx file under src/ (outside the design root) sets `style={{ color: '#333' }}` while the repository has a design root.
A .css file in the design root's components layer declares `background: rgba(0,0,0,.5)`.
A .ts file renders an HTML template literal containing `style="color: hsl(0 0% 20%)"` or a `<style>` block with a hex color.
An .html/.jsx file sets a `fill`, `stroke` or `bgcolor` attribute to a hex color.
doesNotFire: The repository has no design, design_system or design-system directory.
The raw color is in a file under the tokens/foundations layer.
The raw color is a custom property definition such as `--danger: #b91c1c`.
The value is a named color (`red`, `white`), `currentColor` or `transparent`.
The file is a test file (*.test.*, *.spec.*) or lives in a vendored/build directory.
A `#fade:hover {` selector, or a hex inside .ts/.mts code, comments or regex literals.

given: A repository that has a design root, and a UI file anywhere in it (.tsx, .jsx, .html, .htm, .css, or HTML authored in .ts/.mts literals) outside the tokens/foundations layer
when: A color is written in a CSS declaration, style attribute, <style> block, JSX style={{…}} object, or fill/stroke/bgcolor attribute
then: Define the required color once in the tokens layer and reference that token (`var(--…)`) from UI code; never write a raw hex, rgb()/rgba() or hsl()/hsla() literal in the value.
prefer: During GREEN: reuse an existing semantic color token when it already expresses the required role.
During GREEN: add the smallest new semantic token only when the current visual behavior needs a distinct value.
During GREEN: change only the affected UI reference.
avoid: Do not broaden: retheming unrelated components.
Do not broaden: duplicating an existing token under a new name.
Do not broaden: using a raw literal as a temporary shortcut.
unless: Custom property definitions (`--danger: #b91c1c`) define tokens wherever they live and are not flagged.
Named colors (`red`, `white`) and `currentColor`/`transparent` are not flagged.
why: A raw color is a theme decision made in one place: it does not follow dark mode, drifts from the palette, and nobody can find it when the palette changes.
evidence: The current visual or behavioral acceptance passes.
Affected UI files contain no raw color literal outside the tokens layer (bun_design_system_detector reports no finding).
verifier_detail: Raw color literal = a hex (`#rgb`/`#rrggbb`/`#rrggbbaa`), `rgb()`/`rgba()`, or `hsl()`/`hsla()` color written in a declaration value.

Scanned contexts: CSS declarations, `style` attributes, `<style>` blocks, JSX `style={{…}}` objects, `fill`/`stroke`/`bgcolor` attributes in .tsx, .jsx, .html, .htm, .css; plus inline `style="…"` attributes and `<style>` text in HTML a .ts/.mts file renders from string/template/tagged-template literals.
Detector reads declarations from stylesheets, style attributes, style blocks, JSX style objects and .ts/.mts literal HTML, and flags raw color literals in their values.
Selectors are not values: `#fade:hover {` is never read as a color.

Design root = a directory named `design`, `design_system`, or `design-system`. The first directory beneath it names the layer: `tokens` or `foundations`, `primitives`, `components`, `templates`. A repository with no design root is not judged (self-scoping): there is no system to connect to yet. UI files outside the design root are judged when a design root exists.
The tokens/foundations layer is where raw colors are defined and is not scanned.
Test files (`*.test.*`, `*.spec.*`) and vendored/build directories are never scanned.
Custom property definitions (`--name: <color>`) are not flagged anywhere; named colors, `currentColor`, `transparent` are not flagged.
Only literal text is judged in .ts/.mts files: code, comments and regex literals are never read as declarations; a value spanning a `${…}` interpolation is judged on its literal chunks alone.
audit: schema_version 1.1.0; kind rule; status active; introduced_in 0.2.0.
Bun realization of core obligation `coder.design.token-color`, mirroring `coder.vite.design-token-color`.
Source name: UI files use color tokens, not raw color literals.
